answer: The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in ferrous, expire in signal, and vine lists each expiry. Someone running 68 aliases as a result needs 22 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1147 identities would post 3665 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
